record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, jointly set NUM_BLOCKS=8, DROPOUT_RATE=0.2 and LR=1e-3, retaining MAXLEN=64 and hidden size 64. Greater convolution depth may improve context processing, with stronger dropout controlling added capacity and the higher learning rate accelerating fitting. Preserve existing prefix-length features, embedding design, readout, pointwise loss and optimizer type. Keep one model per category, fixed seeds, 200 batches per epoch and the 200-epoch cap; synchronize checkpoint metadata and predictor construction.

category_rationales.rationale: Across all four datasets, increase convolution depth from six to eight blocks, raise dropout to 0.2 to regularize the added capacity, and raise learning rate to 1e-3 to accelerate fitting. Retain history length 64, hidden size 64, existing features, tied embeddings, scoring, readout, pointwise loss and Adam optimizer. Existing checkpoint metadata and predictor construction already synchronize block count. Preserve one checkpoint per category, seeds and training limits; require the supplied data
